verdict.rationale: Spline publishes a pricing page (spline.design/pricing) that lists plan features such as code and self-hosted exports, file version history and Team Library, so some tier-based feature gating is published. The pack shows nothing about seat types, tier names or prices, or which AI features (AI Agent, AI textures, 3D generation) are gated by plan. Missing for 10: seat type definitions, named tiers and prices, AI-feature gating per plan, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement
